summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second-quarter FYE27 earnings press release for the period ended July 31, 2026. Revenue rose about 12% to $109.2 million, software revenue grew 20.9% to $100.8 million, recurring revenue increased 18.4% to $56.2 million, adjusted EBITDA rose 35.7% to $14.9 million, and non-GAAP diluted EPS nearly doubled to $0.15. Management reiterated its FYE27 outlook. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings current report mapped to a US Form 8-K, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated.
